note: Functional probes verify agriai-engine COMPUTES deterministically, not merely that it is alive. Only the compute-only /v1/replay/verify endpoint is declared: it recomputes replay_hash = sha256(canonical(inputs) + engine_version) from caller-supplied inputs, so a probe run needs no DB/Redis/NATS and no outbound provider call (recommend/simulate/plan are deliberately excluded — they pull agronomic context builders whose sufficiency rules are exercised in the service's own unit tests). The endpoint is token-gated; the plan declares only the ${SAHOOL_AGENT_TOKEN} variable NAME (expanded at --run time), never a secret value. The expected hash is derived by executing replay.compute_replay_hash directly on the same inputs (engine_version defaults to agriai-engine/9.1.0), so a determinism regression flips verified to false. Producing evidence and setting runtime_verified is a separate, deliberate step; this plan alone changes nothing in the runtime ledger.
